title: My Silly Little Life

youtube_title: Three weeks of perfect little days. My roommate knows exactly why 🍞
description:
Omar is having the best three weeks of his life: perfect toast, paired socks and a parking spot with a cone on it. His roommate Jess is very quiet about it. The toaster is not.

#cartoon #animation #funny #roommates #shorts
tiktok_caption: my silly little life, day twenty one of nothing going wrong 🍞 #cartoon #animation #funny #roommates

lines.text: Welcome to my silly little life. Today the toast came out perfect.
It is toast, Omar. It is bread that got warm.
I am the toaster. I do not usually do perfect. I do mostly black.
Golden. Both sides. Like a little sunset you can butter.
Please do not narrate breakfast.
Win number two. Every sock in my drawer has a partner.
For the first time since college. Nobody is single.
He cried a little. The socks were not ready for that.
Maybe the laundry fairy did it.
There is no laundry fairy. There is only the universe, and it loves me.
Win number three. My plant has a new leaf.
Your plant is plastic.
And yet. A new leaf.
Someone glued it on. I saw a hand. I did not see a face.
Win number four. The mail came, and it was not a bill.
What was it?
A coupon. For one free toast.
That coupon was handwritten. In purple pen.
Lots of people have purple pens.
Win number five. The parking spot right in front of the building.
It had a little cone on it. Like it was saving it for me.
Huh. Weird. Cones. Out in the world.
Jess, there are three weeks of little wins. Every single day.
Green lights. Clean mirror. My favorite song on the radio when I start the car.
Someone tunes his radio at night. I hear the car door.
I think I am finally the main character.
Or. Hear me out. Someone feels very, very guilty.
Guilty about what?
Here it comes. I am going to pop.
Omar. In October, I broke your mug.
My mug? The one that says world's okayest roommate?
I was making soup in it. It went in the microwave. It made a sound like a goose.
You hid my mug for three weeks?
I could not tell you. You talk to that mug.
I say good morning to it. That is manners.
So I started making you little wins. One a day. As an apology.
You paired my socks?
Two hours. One sock was in the freezer. I do not want to know.
You glued a leaf on my plastic plant?
With craft glue. It was a very real leaf. From the park.
The cone?
I stood in that spot for forty minutes. A man yelled at me.
And the toast. She cleaned me with a toothbrush. I feel brand new.
So my silly little life is just you. Doing stuff.
Your silly little life was always you being weird and happy. I just added cones.
Jess, this is the nicest apology anyone has ever given me.
It was supposed to be one day. It got out of hand.
She bought a second toaster. As a backup. I am not okay with that.
Where is the mug now?
In a shoebox. In nine pieces. With a little card.
Get the glue.
Omar, it is nine pieces.
Nine pieces is a puzzle. Puzzles are a win.
Twenty minutes later.
Look at him. A little crooked. A little leaky. Still okayest.
It leaks out of the word world.
Win number forty. My mug came home.
Can I stop doing the cones now?
Absolutely not.
